name: PersonalRecommendations
description: Builds a per-user taste profile from previously watched movies and series (genres, cast, crew, studios) and shows a "Recommended For You" row on the home screen for every user, kept up to date on a schedule and after playback.
overview: Personalized recommendations based on watch history
changelog: 0.3.2: Fixed the widget not appearing on a confirmed 10.11.11 build — the home screen's row container is added by React after the home tab itself, and the previous DOM-change detection was too narrow to catch that moment. It now reacts to any DOM/class change on the page (still cheap and debounced) instead of specific nodes/attributes, and logs are de-duplicated so the console doesn't flood. 0.3.1: Added diagnostic console logging. 0.3.0: Replaced the private playlist with a "Recommended For You" home screen widget (web/app clients) — series now show as themselves instead of their next unwatched episode. Existing pre-0.3.0 playlists are automatically removed on first startup after upgrading. 0.2.1: Non-blocking refresh. 0.2.0: Switched from collections to playlists (superseded by 0.3.0). 0.1.0: Initial release.
